commits.author: Matt
commits.subject: fix(model): preserve provider prefix and sanitize carriage returns in /model set
commits.body:
- Remove stripProviderPrefix() from model.ts cache and autocomplete.
  Models from 'opencode models' already include provider prefix
  (e.g. 'opencode/minimax-m2.5-free'), so stripping it caused
  'Model not found' errors.

- Add shared sanitizeModel() utility in src/utils/stringUtils.ts
  that strips carriage returns (\r) and applies it consistently
  across model.ts, dataStore.ts, and sessionManager.ts.

- Strip \r in dataStore.setChannelModel/getChannelModel to prevent
  corrupted storage.

- Omit model field entirely from prompt_async body when it cannot be
  parsed (no '/' separator), rather than sending a raw string which
  would cause a Zod validation 400 error.

- Improve error logging in sendPrompt to include server response body
  for easier debugging.

- Fix test: add text() mock and update error message assertion.

commits.author: Choi wontak
commits.subject: fix(execution): prevent silent error swallowing in Discord message handling
commits.body:
Errors in updateStreamMessage (message edit) were silently caught,
causing AI responses to be lost while '✅ Done' still appeared.
Now all edit failures fall back to sending new messages, ensuring
users always see output or error details in Discord.

Closes #32
